about_title: About Mochifile — simple file tools for everyone
about_description: Mochifile makes simple file tools for people who just want the job done. They run in your browser, the code is open source, and your files stay on your device.
sustainability_description: An honest account of Mochifile's footprint: smaller files, tools that run on your own device, light static pages, and what we do not claim.
architecture_description: How Mochifile is built and why your files never leave your device: browser-only tools, a strict Content Security Policy, and limits that protect your phone.
contact_description: Write to the Mochifile team: questions, problems with a tool or ideas. Security reports go to security@mochifile.com.
